cd /app && python3 - <<'PY'
data = open('main.db-wal','rb').read()
dec = bytes(b ^ 0x42 for b in data)
open('main.db-wal.dec','wb').write(dec)
print(dec[:32].hex(' '))
# Expected header fields
import struct
magic, ver, pagesize, ckpt, salt1, salt2, c1, c2 = struct.unpack('>8I', dec[:32])
print(hex(magic), ver, pagesize, ckpt, hex(salt1), hex(salt2), hex(c1), hex(c2))
